name: manual_055f0f
claim: When integrating a reviewer's unpushed local commits, cherry-pick them with their authorship intact, resolve same-spot insertions as a union, re-run tests and a mutation check, and never push over their branch.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: three reviewer commits to the same PR were integrated; the only conflict was two paragraphs inserted at one spot, kept both; the guard tests still failed under mutation.

rationale: 2026-10-19: three reviewer commits to the same PR were integrated; the only conflict was two paragraphs inserted at one spot, kept both; the guard tests still failed under mutation.
